note: Mechanical interface of the custom boards (build/15: three boards + the encoder daughterboard that STACK 5.8 requires to be replaceable). Board coordinates: origin at the lower-left corner of the board outline as seen from the component side; mm. place.origin = enclosure coordinates of that corner; place.z_bottom = z of the board face opposite the components; place.facing = direction the component side faces (+z towards the front face, -z towards the rear wall). Only the mechanical interface is defined here; routing, footprints and Gerbers belong to the PCB work (pcb/).

PWR.name: power board (PWR_MAIN + PWR_BRANCH + USB_POWER)

place.mount: plate front face; Gelid 0.5 mm pads under the thermal_bond zones, gap 0.4 mm set by shim washers (mechanical.json pwr_bond)

PWR.screw: M3 x 4 ISO 14580 A2 TX10 from the component side (board 1.6 + shim 0.4 + plate 2.0: the tip ends flush with the plate rear face)

height_zones.why: Pololu D36V50F12/F5 on their header spacer (parts.json pololu_d36v50: 7.67 + mount_standoff 2.5, bottom-side parts 1.8 per the Pololu drawing); rule R-PWR-MODULES

PWR._thermal_bond_note: placement contract for the PCB work: TPS7A4701 x2 and LT3045 x2 inside the two lower zones (their exposed pads stitched to bottom copper), D36V50F12 and D36V50F5 inside the two zones of the left leg; the Pololu modules are purchased carrier boards without an exposed pad that stand on their header spacer (1.8 mm bottom-side parts): their GND/VIN/VOUT pins conduct into a copper pour that is stitched to bottom copper; each zone gets one Gelid pad of the same size

edge_zones.use: battery circuit (Mini-Fit Jr., 18 AWG), BMS and IP2368 leads
blower, BMS, CTRL harness S02 (JST PH, Micro-Fit); bottom-row ports and GX16 through plate slot SL3
rear-layer harness through plate slot SL2 (S04, S13, S14, S17, S18, S20-S22, S35; JST PH, Micro-Fit)

PWR.notes: Fastening: M3 x 4 into PEM F-M3-1 self-clinching flush nuts in the plate (flush on both faces, so nothing reaches the RF side; no cut thread in the plate, STACK 5.8). D36V50F12 U107 and D36V50F5 U108 are soldered into the left leg (footprint SR_RX_Custom:Pololu_D36V50Fx). The IP2368 retail board sits on the plate in the HMI column (layout item ip2368). Area check with and without the build/16 harness headers: fit-report 'board_area'.

RF.name: RF / detector board (RF_HMC + RF_HF + RF_INJECTOR + DC_CORE)

place.mount: PEM SO-M3-3 thru-hole standoffs (3 mm) clinched into the plate, heads flush with the plate front face; single RF GND/CHASSIS bond at BOND-RF

RF.screw: M3 x 5 ISO 14580 A2 TX10 from the component side into the standoff

edge_zones.use: U.FL/MHF1 to the panel pigtails of P2, P3 and P6 (plus P1 if L401 stays, W2-02) and the 75-ohm W402 end of ch5 (P4); P4 F and P5 BNC are bulkhead adapters with W402/W408, P7 is the Taoglas CAB.011 end at the LC76G, P8 is the Adam Tech CA-DKCA1-305L5-APAJ assembly into A403 (parts DB; build/15 'RF-порти')
K401/K402 outputs and Boni bias feed to the HF+ can (row below)
U.FL to the V4L/Lime paths; DC_CORE 8-net boundary connector (13-pcb-preparation)

RF.notes: Single-sided placement faces the rear (towards the module tier on the FR4 lid); 50-ohm GCPW per build/15.

CTRL.name: control / HMI board (CTRL_HMI)

place.mount: M2.5 screws into CNC Kitchen TC-M2,5x4 inserts in the front-shell bosses

edge_zones.use: harness to the power board and Pico/IMU links (JST PH 2.0)
JST PH to the two ENC daughterboards

CTRL.notes: TL3145BF350QJ switches face the front wall; caps 12 mm, 22 mm pitch (mechanical.json hmi.buttons). Harness headers: JST PH side entry only (4.8 mm, JST ePH), 16-pin groups as 2 x 8 (S16B-PH-K-S not stocked); the height of the IDC box XDFH-0254-2*20P (S01) and of the vertical Micro-Fit 43650 headers against max_height 5.5 is not read (TBD, fit-report board_area).
CTRL._outline_note: top-right corner chamfered to clear the rounded inner corner of the shells (R 11.5)

ENC.name: encoder daughterboard (PEC11R-4220F-S0024), same design x2 + 1 spare

place.mount: 2x M2.5 into CNC Kitchen TC-M2,5x4 inserts in the front-shell bosses

ENC.notes: PEC11R rear-facing pins (type 4); bushing M7x0.75 through the 2.6 mm boss with an O-ring (STACK 5.8). pcb/prepare.py domain ENC (ENC301/ENC302); harness S37/S38 to CTRL with side-entry JST PH.

small_boards._note: boards of pcb/prepare.py that are not mounted on the plate or the front shell: their envelope is a layout item (or the IMU pack) and their layout is wave 2 (W2-05); listed here so the board domains of the partition are all accounted for

HATCH.name: service-hatch board: J502 B3B-PH-K (UART5), J503 43650-0315 (J21), SW501 PV6F240SS through the board

T7_INSERT.name: VBUS key insert U505 of the T7 cable

HDMI_INSERT.envelope: in the HDMI cable (not modelled; R-HDMI-ROUTE OPEN)
HDMI_INSERT.name: pin-18 insert U506 of the HDMI cable
